spanish: Todo hiriente alma, sobre boca de testigos matará al matador; y testigo uno no responderá en alma para morir.

findings.issue: לְ on the construct «mouth» is to/for/according-to; «sobre» renders it as upon/over.

notes: The rest keeps the tokens: every soul-striker, witnesses’ mouth, 3ms will slay the slayer; one witness will not answer in a soul to die.
